title: 第18章 魔药第19章 呓语
slug: 诡秘星轨交织的夜第222章
content_zh:
莫甘娜紧绷的身体放松下来，轻轻吐出一口气，“谢谢你的帮助，邓恩队长。”
“不必客气。正好今天没有紧急任务，我会亲自看顾你的晋升。”邓恩站起身，高大的身躯给人一种可靠的安全感。
“有劳了。”
两人离开办公室，走在略显空旷的走廊上。
石砌的墙壁带着凉意，脚步声在廊道里产生轻微的回响。
邓恩步伐稳健，莫甘娜则稍慢半步，她的心神已经提前飞向了那场即将到来的、凶吉未卜的晋升仪式。
就在他们穿过一条连接主楼与侧翼的拱廊时，一个身影有些百无聊赖地靠在廊柱旁，似乎正在躲懒？
那人有着一头微卷的黑发，绿色眼睛，面容英俊，穿着却有点随意，有几分诗人般的随性气质，正是莫甘娜之前匆匆见过一面的午夜诗人——伦纳德。
伦纳德看到邓恩和莫甘娜，眼睛一亮，立刻站直了身体。
“队长！”伦纳德打招呼道，随即目光好奇地落在莫甘娜身上，“这位小姐，又见到您了，您怎么来了？”
“伦纳德，”邓恩停下脚步，虽然之前见过一面，但到底没有介绍过，还是简单地为双方介绍了一下，“这位是莫甘娜·维斯珀小姐，莫甘娜，这位是伦纳德·米切尔，我们的队员，不眠者途径。”
“你好，米切尔先生。”莫甘娜礼貌地点头致意，她的注意力大部分还沉浸在自己的思绪里，显得有些心不在焉。
“你好，莫甘娜，我觉得这样比较顺口，你应该不会介意吧。”伦纳德饶有兴趣地打量着这位陌生的、气质独特的女士，之前想找机会接触一下这位学徒的小姐，但是因为种种原因，一直没有时间，没有想到，今天就这样遇到了。
“当然不会，伦纳德。”
“你们这是要去哪里……？”看到莫甘娜有些心不在焉，伦纳德询问道。
邓恩言简意赅的回答，“莫甘娜需要晋升，我们现在要去老尼尔那里。”
伦纳德眼中的好奇更浓了。
晋升？
伦纳德心思活络起来，这是多好的，接触这位学徒的机会呀。
“队长，反正我现在也没任务，”伦纳德脸上露出一个爽朗的笑容，主动请缨，“需要帮忙吗？多个人也多份照应。”

邓恩看向莫甘娜，用眼神询问她的意见。
毕竟这是她的晋升仪式，是否需要更多旁观者，应该由她决定。
莫甘娜从自己的思绪中回过神，看了看伦纳德。
她对这个英俊中带着点痞气的年轻值夜者第一印象不算坏，而且他眼神清澈，气息沉稳，魔药应该消化的不错，序列8，也有战斗力。
想到晋升时可能出现的意外，多一个可靠的帮手确实更好。
content_en:
Morgana's tense body relaxed and she breathed out gently, "Thank you for your help, Captain Dunn."
"You're welcome. It just so happens that there are no urgent tasks today. I will personally take care of your promotion." Dunn stood up, his tall body giving people a reliable sense of security.
"Good work."
The two left the office and walked down the slightly empty corridor.
The stone walls felt cool, and the footsteps echoed slightly in the corridor.
Dunn's steps were steady, while Morgana was half a step slower. Her mind had already flown to the upcoming and uncertain promotion ceremony in advance.
Just as they passed through an arcade connecting the main building and the side wings, a figure leaned against the pillars in boredom, seeming to be lazy?
The man had slightly curly black hair, green eyes, and a handsome face. He was dressed a bit casually and had a poet-like casual temperament. He was Leonard, the midnight poet whom Morgana had briefly met before.
When Leonard saw Dunn and Morgana, his eyes lit up and he immediately stood up straight.
"Captain!" Leonard greeted, and then his eyes fell on Morgana curiously, "Miss, I see you again, why are you here?"
"Leonard," Dunn stopped. Although they had met before, they had never introduced each other before. He still briefly introduced both parties, "This is Miss Morgana Vesper. Morgana, this is Leonard Mitchell, our team member, the Sleepless Path."
"Hello, Mr. Mitchell." Morgana nodded politely. Most of her attention was still immersed in her own thoughts, and she seemed a little absent-minded.
"Hello, Morgana, I think this is more fluent. You shouldn't mind." Leonard looked at this strange and unique lady with interest. He had wanted to find a chance to meet this apprentice lady before, but due to various reasons, he never had time. He didn't expect that he would meet him like this today.
"Of course not, Leonard."
"Where are you going...?" Seeing that Morgana was a little distracted, Leonard asked.
Dunn answered concisely and concisely, "Morgana needs to be promoted, and we are going to Old Neil now."
The curiosity in Leonard's eyes became even stronger.
Promotion?
Leonard's mind became active. What a great opportunity to get in touch with this apprentice.
"Captain, I don't have any tasks anyway," Leonard said with a hearty smile on his face and volunteered, "Do you need help? Multiple people will take care of you."
Dunn looked at Morgana and asked her opinion with his eyes.
After all, this is her promotion ceremony, and it should be up to her to decide whether she needs more bystanders.
Morgana came out of her thoughts and looked at Leonard.
Her first impression of this handsome and somewhat ruffian young Nighthawk was not bad. Moreover, his eyes were clear and his breath was calm. He should be able to digest the potion well. He was at Sequence 8 and had fighting ability.
Considering the possible surprises when getting promoted, it is indeed better to have one more reliable helper.
